title: Voynich MS - Text Analysis - the Writing System (Month names in the zodiac section)
summary: The section inventories the Latin-script month annotations by folio and zodiac sign and attributes the annotations to a later hand. Zandbergen favors Northern French and cites comparable spellings on an astrolabe from that region, alongside earlier Spanish and Occitan suggestions.
established: The table covers twelve surviving panels and ten distinct signs, from Pisces through Sagittarius. Both Aries panels are listed for April and both Taurus panels for May.

The month table records writing in the central drawings. The same page separately inventories Voynich-script labels by the stars, so the month inventory supplies locations for checking the proposed anchor pairings.
